general_information.test_case_name: Poisson on cube strong scaling test
general_information.test_case_description: Strong scaling of the Poisson model with manufactured solution on 3D cube.
general_information.simulation_description:
Strong scaling test for Poisson equation on a 3D cube.
The manufactured solution is a simple product of sines and cosines.
Homogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions are set in direction x.
